Question: Pesticide and fertilizer use on crops affects water purity when

Options: 
A. evaporation is increased by heat
B. it is used sparingly
C. there is too little rainfall
D. it is used in proper amounts
E. runoff joins with surface and/or groundwater

Provide the correct letter choice in \boxed{X}, where X is the correct letter choice. Keep the explanation or feedback within 3 sentences.
